motion.experience: Chronological cards stay in normal document flow; the card nearest the viewport center moves forward while upcoming cards rise from below and past cards recede upward. CSS transitions reverse on scroll-up and honor reduced-motion preferences.
motion.opening: A restrained word reveal writes PULKIT, then scales and moves into the matching cover headline; no portal artwork is used.

must: Keep the portfolio's navy, cyan and red Earth-928 visual identity.
Keep experience and community roles in chronological scroll order.
avoid: Avoid overlapping experience cards and manual carousel controls.
Avoid literal portal imagery and decorative effects that compete with the portfolio content.

decisions.decision: Experience and writing cards remain in chronological document flow. The nearest card rises into focus; previous cards move up and fade while upcoming cards rise from below. The states reverse naturally when scrolling upward.
decisions.source: User asked for a bottom-to-front card transition with fading on scroll and rejected the existing blurred, disappearing card treatment.

decisions.decision: The opening writes PULKIT and transforms that word into the matching cover headline; the provided portal reference is not embedded or redrawn literally.
